Interface Converter<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of the class that should be returned from the conversion.
All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
ByteSizeConverter, DurationConverter
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Converter<T> extends Serializable
Converter interface specifies how to convert an input string coming from a property value to a target object returned by the Config method.
Since:
1.0.4

  • Method Details

    • convert

      T convert(Method method, String input)
      Converts the given input into an Object of type T. If the method returns null, null will be returned by the Config object.

      A converter named by a class is instantiated for every call, so one written that way should have no internal state. A converter registered as an instance — Factory.setTypeConverter(Class, Converter), since 2.0.0 — is the object you handed over, and lives as long as the factory does: it is then yours to make thread safe, and it travels with the configuration when the configuration is serialized, which is why this interface is Serializable as Loader and ValueHandler are.

      Parameters:
      method - the method invoked on the Config object
      input - the property value specified as input text to be converted to the T return type
      Returns:
      the object of type T converted from the input string.
      Since:
      1.0.4
